quote: OpenAI today launched GPT–6 Sol and GPT–6 Luna, two new models that follow GPT–6 Astra.
note: Lab (OpenAI) and kind (shipped model) confirmed. The MacRumors article is bylined "Tuesday September 22, 2026 1:58 pm PDT by Juli Clover"; the quote is from its body. Rollout: "GPT–6 Sol and GPT–6 Luna are rolling out in ChatGPT Work and Codex starting today" for eligible paid users (Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu), and both are in the API as gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-luna. Free and Go users could try Luna only. Secondary sources (letsdatascience.com, dated Sept 22, 2026, and an OpenAI X post) say the same date and cite OpenAI's post "Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna" at https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-sol-and-luna/, but openai.com and X returned HTTP 403/402 to WebFetch, so OpenAI's own page was not read verbatim. Some sources give a Sept 17 launch date; that came from an unofficial account and is contradicted by the Sept 22 announcement. Later sources name a GPT-6.1 Sol (Sept 29 per ChatGPT release notes, as reported by a secondary source); that is a different model and is not used here. No separate preview before general availability was found.
queries: openai.com introducing GPT-6 Sol Luna announcement
